_comment: Copy this file to config.json next to provider.py, or point NOETIC_CONFIG at it. The environment wins over the file: NOETIC_PROVIDER, NOETIC_MODEL_C / _N / _V / _S, NOETIC_MAX_TOKENS_C / _N / _V / _S. Nothing is read from this example file: only config.json, or the file NOETIC_CONFIG names, is used, so with neither the system runs exactly as it always did (Anthropic, claude-sonnet-4-6). No keys belong in this file: set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or OPENROUTER_API_KEY in the environment.

V._note: A reasoning model spends part of the reply limit on its reasoning, so it needs more than the 600 this agent has by default.

_ids: OpenRouter ids are vendor/model and use dots in versions. Checked against OpenRouter's public model list on 2026-11-04: present: anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5, anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6, anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5, google/gemini-2.5-pro, x-ai/grok-4.3, deepseek/deepseek-r1-0528, openai/gpt-5.1. Absent that day: anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5 (hyphens), google/gemini-pro-1.5, x-ai/grok-3, deepseek/deepseek-r1.
